messages:
sophia: Quick heads-up — I ran a p99 tailbench across us/eu/apac for the 7B model (llama2-ish) comparing A100 vs H100 under a mixed QPS (50% short prompts, 50% long streaming). APAC H100 p99 is blowing up (~2.1s) while A100 there is ~1.4s. US/EU are fine. Anyone seen this pattern? dropping logs + config below.

miguel: can you paste the exact run command and kernel flags you used?

sophia: sure — ran our standard perf-runner with these knobs: 
```
./perf-runner --model open-7b --quant none --qps-mix short:0.5,long:0.5 --seq-prefill 512 --seq-decode 1024 --batching auto --kernel_policy hybrid --regions us-west1,eu-west1,asia-northeast1 --reps 10
```
also set kernel_policy=hybrid which lets runtime pick H100-optimized kernels first, fall back to generic when needed.

perf-bot: job 1745006789 queued by sophia. summary will be posted when complete. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

raj: hmm. APAC H100 p99 spikes smell like NUMA / peer-to-peer variability on the instance SKU we're hitting. We saw similar with dense attention kernels where the fast kernel assumes contiguous GPU memory layout; when page migration or PCIe churn occurs it falls back and causes long tail. Did you observe kernel fallthrough counts?

sophia: good call. fallthroughs: hybrid_fallbacks=436 across 10 reps in asia-northeast1. us-west1 fallthroughs=12.

jana: sharing a tiny snapshot of the numbers from the run (median/p99 tokens/sec and cost-per-1M tokens):

region,gpu,median_prefill_ms,p99_decode_ms,tokens_per_sec,cost_per_1M
us-west1,H100,120,340,1200,$1.80
us-west1,A100,140,360,900,$1.05
eu-west1,H100,130,380,1100,$1.95
eu-west1,A100,155,400,880,$1.10
asia-northeast1,H100,220,2100,600,$3.45
asia-northeast1,A100,180,1400,650,$2.10

jana: key takeaway — APAC H100 has worse p99 and lower tokens/sec vs A100 for this mix; cost per 1M also higher due to lower throughput and p99 SLOs forcing smaller batches.

miguel: oof. could be a driver-level issue on our APAC image (CUDA/driver mismatch) or cloud host oversubscription. Can we repro with explicit kernel override? try forcing 'dense_attn_generic' on H100 and see if p99 improves (hoping to avoid hybrid fallback thrash).

sophia: yep, queued a quick run with --kernel_override=dense_attn_generic on asia-northeast1. results in ~p99 720ms (huge improvement) but tokens/sec drops to 480. tradeoff looks like stable latency vs throughput.

raj: that suggests the hybrid path was bouncing between fast/hot kernels and generic ones; the cache/placement thrash kills the fast kernel latency when fallback happens mid-request. Options: 1) pin kernel to generic (stable lower throughput), 2) change instance SKU / topology in APAC (reduce NUMA cross-talk), 3) tune kernel selection threshold (prefers generic under noisy hosts).

jana: also tried quant int8 on A100 in APAC — quality regression on our eval set: ~0.7% BLEU/ROUGE drop for generative tests. For embedding tasks it's fine. So can't blanket int8 for generation yet.

sophia: cost calc for a quick decision: if we prefer stability and choose A100 in APAC for this workload, the $/1M tokens delta is roughly +$0.35 vs H100 best-case but H100 unstable p99 raises SLA risk (alerts, retries). For throughput-first apps H100 still wins in US/EU.

sre-team: can we get a repro job with resource traces enabled (nvlink/pcie counters + kernel fallthrough timestamps)? we'll run host-side checks for driver/kernel versions across regions. @perf-bot please schedule 3 repro runs with --trace-host and keep the same qps-mix.

perf-bot: scheduled job 1745006901, 1745006930, 1745006995 with --trace-host; will post artifacts to /mnt/perf/1745006789/

miguel: SGTM. action items: (1) reproduce with traces (sre), (2) try kernel_override generic vs tuned thresholds (eng-ml), (3) evaluate temporary canary route to A100 for APAC 5% traffic + fallback.

sophia: I'll prepare a 5% canary config for eu/asia to route to A100 with automatic fallback to H100 if cost too high. will also add an eval run for int8 on a held-out prompt set to quantify quality delta.

jana: FYI linking the dashboard snapshot: https://redwood-internal/perf/dash/1745006789 (contains latency percentiles, fallthrough heatmap, tokens/sec over time).

sophia: thanks all — will post final repro artifacts once perf-bot finishes. tagging this thread for follow-up after traces: @miguel @raj @sre-team :white_check_mark:
